description: Na₂Co₃H₁₀(SO₆)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.81 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₆ octahedra, corners with three SO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-61°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.19 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent CoO₆ octahedra and corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-61°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.22 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-62°. There is one shorter (1.48 Å) and three longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-50°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Co and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Co, and two H atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Co and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Co and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Co and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Co and one H atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms.
